Route and source accommodation summary/table agree on 2 Bogotá + 2 Pereira + 1 Cartagena + 3 San Andrés + 2 Medellín = 10 nights. Latest Word has one Cartagena night at body child 99, so the old RU warning of a two-night table discrepancy is no longer supported by this revision. English private guides, private transfers, San Andrés all-inclusive and excluded internal flights agree.

Full 2027 tariff table at body child 102 preserves SGL/DBL/TRP for both categories: 4★ 8622/4523/4456 USD; 5★ 9637/5282/4776 USD. All six amounts match RU; retain hotel/room bases and updated one-night Cartagena allocation.
